name: optimize_ts_array_find_in_loop
description: Array.prototype.find() per lookup inside a loop -> a Map built once; budget calibrated (naive ~3.7s native at n=60k vs ~0.01s, budget 1.5s); wrong-output broken lets duplicate ids resolve to the LAST occurrence instead of the first
prompts: sumForIds(items, ids) in lookup.ts sums the value of the item matching each id in `ids` - but it calls items.find(...) for every id, a full linear scan of items each time, making the whole function O(n*m). Rewrite it to build a Map from items to their value ONCE before the loop, then look up each id in O(1). Preserve the exact tie-break behavior: if items contains a duplicate id, the FIRST occurrence's value must be used (matching what Array.prototype.find would have returned) - do not let a later duplicate silently overwrite it. Keep the function name, signature, and export.
check_command: tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build lookup.ts test_lookup.ts && node build/test_lookup.js
